title_ar: فتوى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو بخصوص قانون النوع في موريتانيا
title_en: The Fatwa of His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Concerning the Gender Law in Mauritania
body_ar:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على سيد الأولين والآخرين نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته إخوتي من يصله هذا من أهلنا في موريتانيا أجمعين أردت أن أبين القدر المتفق عليه الذي لا يختلف فيه اثنان من المسلمين المتبعين لما جاء به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من عند الله تعالى فيما يتعلق بهذا القانون المثير للجدل.

أولا: أن المسلمين متفقون جميعا على أن الله تعالى هو الذي يحل ويحرم ويجرم وأن من دون الله لا يملك ذلك٬ فالله سبحانه هو الحكم وحده. قال تعالى: (إن الحكم إلا لله) وقال تعالى: ( وما اختلفتم فيه من شيء فحكمه إلى الله)، وهو الذي يشرع وحده والتشريع من خصائص الإلهية ولذلك قال الله تعالى: ﴿أَم لَهُم شُرَكاءُ شَرَعوا لَهُم مِنَ الدّينِ ما لَم يَأذَن بِهِ اللَّهُ﴾ [الشورى: ٢١]

وقال تعالى: ﴿قُل أَرَأَيتُم ما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُم مِن رِزقٍ فَجَعَلتُم مِنهُ حَرامًا وَحَلالًا قُل آللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُم أَم عَلَى اللَّهِ تَفتَرونَ﴾ [يونس: ٥٩] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلا تَقولوا لِما تَصِفُ أَلسِنَتُكُمُ الكَذِبَ هذا حَلالٌ وَهذا حَرامٌ لِتَفتَروا عَلَى اللَّهِ الكَذِبَ إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَفتَرونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الكَذِبَ لا يُفلِحونَ﴾ [النحل: ١١٦] وقال تعالى: ﴿قُل إِنَّما حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الفَواحِشَ ما ظَهَرَ مِنها وَما بَطَنَ وَالإِثمَ وَالبَغيَ بِغَيرِ الحَقِّ وَأَن تُشرِكوا بِاللَّهِ ما لَم يُنَزِّل بِهِ سُلطانًا وَأَن تَقولوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ما لا تَعلَمونَ﴾ [الأعراف: ٣٣]

فلا يحل لأي إنسان أن يشرع ما لم يأذن به الله٬ ولا أن يسعى لتقرير ذلك ولا أن يوقع عليه ولا أن يصوت له ولا أن يشارك في إقراره فالله سبحانه وتعالى هو الذي يحل ويحرم ومن قرر خلاف شرعه أن أحل ما حرم الله أو حرم ما أحل الله فقد حاد الله في ملكه.

ثانيا: أن الله سبحانه وتعالى حرم الزنى وجعله فاحشة من أكبر الكبائر ورتب عليه حدا من حدوده سواء كان هذا الزنى بمحرم أو أجنبية بكبيرة أو صغيرة بطائعة أو مكرهة بأي حال من الأحوال. فالزنى من أكبر الفواحش ولذلك قال الله تعالى: ﴿وَلا تَقرَبُوا الزِّنا إِنَّهُ كانَ فاحِشَةً وَساءَ سَبيلًا﴾ [الإسراء: ٣٢]

وحرم الله سبحانه وتعالى على المؤمن والمؤمنة الاقتراب منه وكل ما يؤدي إليه فأوجب الله على المؤمنين والمؤمنات حفظ فروجهم فقد قال سبحانه وتعالى: ﴿وَالَّذينَ هُم لِفُروجِهِم حافِظونَ ۝ إِلّا عَلى أَزواجِهِم أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمانُهُم فَإِنَّهُم غَيرُ مَلومينَ ۝ فَمَنِ ابتَغى وَراءَ ذلِكَ فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ العادونَ﴾ [المؤمنون: ٥-٧] وقال تعالى: ﴿قُل لِلمُؤمِنينَ يَغُضّوا مِن أَبصارِهِم وَيَحفَظوا فُروجَهُم ذلِكَ أَزكى لَهُم إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبيرٌ بِما يَصنَعونَ ۝ وَقُل لِلمُؤمِناتِ يَغضُضنَ مِن أَبصارِهِنَّ وَيَحفَظنَ فُروجَهُنَّ وَلا يُبدينَ زينَتَهُنَّ إِلّا ما ظَهَرَ مِنها وَليَضرِبنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلى جُيوبِهِنَّ وَلا يُبدينَ زينَتَهُنَّ إِلّا لِبُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو آبائِهِنَّ أَو آباءِ بُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو أَبنائِهِنَّ أَو أَبناءِ بُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو إِخوانِهِنَّ أَو بَني إِخوانِهِنَّ أَو بَني أَخَواتِهِنَّ أَو نِسائِهِنَّ أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمانُهُنَّ أَوِ التّابِعينَ غَيرِ أُولِي الإِربَةِ مِنَ الرِّجالِ أَوِ الطِّفلِ الَّذينَ لَم يَظهَروا عَلى عَوراتِ النِّساءِ وَلا يَضرِبنَ بِأَرجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعلَمَ ما يُخفينَ مِن زينَتِهِنَّ وَتوبوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَميعًا أَيُّهَ المُؤمِنونَ لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ﴾ [النور: ٣٠-٣١]

وقد رتب الله تعالى على الزنى حدا من حدوده فعلى الزاني البكر أوجب الله تعالى جلد مائة وتغريب سنة٬ وعلى الزاني المحصن سواء كان ذكرا أو أنثى فرض رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الرجم إلى الموت. وقد قال تعالى: ﴿الزّانِيَةُ وَالزّاني فَاجلِدوا كُلَّ واحِدٍ مِنهُما مِائَةَ جَلدَةٍ وَلا تَأخُذكُم بِهِما رَأفَةٌ في دينِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُم تُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَاليَومِ الآخِرِ وَليَشهَد عَذابَهُما طائِفَةٌ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ﴾ [النور: ٢]

وقد صح في صحيح البخاري من حديث عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أن مما أنزل الله على رسوله آية الرجم وأن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رجم ورجم معه أصحابه٬ وقد رجم رسول الله عليه وسلم خمسة أشخاص في حياته من الذين زنوا وهم في حال إحصان٬ وقد بين رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كذلك بعض ما يتعلق بالزنى من العقوبات غير هذا كما يتعلق باللعان وانقطاع النسب وغير ذلك٬ وبين الله سبحانه وتعالى في كتابه ما يثبت به الزنى من الشهادة وبين كذلك ما يتم به اللعان من الأيمان.

فكل تحرش أو ما يؤدي إلى اللذة بمن لا يحل للرجل التلذذ بها النساء أو من لا يحل للمرأة التلذذ به من الرجال فهو كذلك من الفواحش والكبائر وما دون الزنى منه رتبت فيه عقوبة تعزيرية يحددها الحاكم بما يكون رادعا للناس.

ولا شك أن الذنوب تزداد بحسب ظروفها فيزدادا عقابها الأخروي وتشدد عقوبتها الدنيوية بحسب ظروفها كذلك. فالزنى بالمحارم أشد من الزنى بالأجنبيات٬ والزنى بالمُكرَهات المغتصبات أشد من الزنى بالطائعات٬ والزنى بالمتزوجات أشد من الزنى بالخوالي لأن كل ذلك فيه حقوق متعدية وقد قال الله سبحانه وتعالى: ﴿وَالَّذينَ لا يَدعونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلهًا آخَرَ وَلا يَقتُلونَ النَّفسَ الَّتي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَلا يَزنونَ وَمَن يَفعَل ذلِكَ يَلقَ أَثامًا ۝ يُضاعَف لَهُ العَذابُ يَومَ القِيامَةِ وَيَخلُد فيهِ مُهانًا ۝ إِلّا مَن تابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صالِحًا فَأُولئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِم حَسَناتٍ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا﴾ [الفرقان: ٦٨-٧٠].

ثالثا: أن الله سبحانه وتعالى قد أعطى كل ذي حق حقه فحدد ما للرجال من الحقوق وما للنساء من الحقوق وبين ذلك في كتابه وبينه رسوله الكريم صلى الله عليه وسلم فقد قال الله سبحانه وتعالى: ﴿وَلَهُنَّ مِثلُ الَّذي عَلَيهِنَّ بِالمَعروفِ وَلِلرِّجالِ عَلَيهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٢٨] وقال تعالى: ﴿فَلا تَعضُلوهُنَّ أَن يَنكِحنَ أَزواجَهُنَّ إِذا تَراضَوا بَينَهُم بِالمَعروفِ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٣٢] وقال تعالى: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذينَ آمَنوا لا يَحِلُّ لَكُم أَن تَرِثُوا النِّساءَ كَرهًا وَلا تَعضُلوهُنَّ لِتَذهَبوا بِبَعضِ ما آتَيتُموهُنَّ إِلّا أَن يَأتينَ بِفاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَعاشِروهُنَّ بِالمَعروفِ فَإِن كَرِهتُموهُنَّ فَعَسى أَن تَكرَهوا شَيئًا وَيَجعَلَ اللَّهُ فيهِ خَيرًا كَثيرًا﴾ [النساء: ١٩].

وعلى هذا فلا يمكن أن يكتسب بعد ذلك حق جديد لأن الله أكمل الدين وقال: ﴿اليَومَ أَكمَلتُ لَكُم دينَكُم وَأَتمَمتُ عَلَيكُم نِعمَتي وَرَضيتُ لَكُمُ الإِسلامَ دينًا﴾ [المائدة: ٣] فالحقوق هي ما حدده الشارع وبينه فهذه هي الحقوق التي جعل الله لكل فرد من المجتمع وهي مبينة واضحة لا إشكال فيها.

رابعا: أن كل تعد على الحقوق أو ظلم فهو أيضا من أكبر الكبائر وأشدها وقد حرم الله الظلم على نفسه وجعله محرما بين عباده كما في الحديث القدسي الصحيح "يا عبادي إني حرمت الظلم على نفسي وجعلته بينكم محرما فلا تظَّالموا" وقد أثنى الله على نفسه بأنه لا يظلم فقال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَظلِمُ النّاسَ شَيئًا وَلكِنَّ النّاسَ أَنفُسَهُم يَظلِمونَ﴾ [يونس: ٤٤] وقال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَظلِمُ مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضاعِفها وَيُؤتِ مِن لَدُنهُ أَجرًا عَظيمًا﴾ [النساء: ٤٠] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَما رَبُّكَ بِظَلّامٍ لِلعَبيدِ﴾ [فصلت: ٤٦] وقد بين الله خطر الظلم وحرمته وضرره فقال تعالى: ﴿وَمَن خَفَّت مَوازينُهُ فَأُولئِكَ الَّذينَ خَسِروا أَنفُسَهُم بِما كانوا بِآياتِنا يَظلِمونَ﴾ [الأعراف: ٩] وقال تعالى: ﴿فَأَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم رِجزًا مِنَ السَّماءِ بِما كانوا يَظلِمونَ﴾ [الأعراف: ١٦٢] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلَو أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفسٍ ظَلَمَت ما فِي الأَرضِ لَافتَدَت بِهِ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدامَةَ لَمّا رَأَوُا العَذابَ وَقُضِيَ بَينَهُم بِالقِسطِ وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ﴾ [يونس: ٥٤] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَمَن يَظلِم مِنكُم نُذِقهُ عَذابًا كَبيرًا﴾ [الفرقان: ١٩] وقال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّمَا السَّبيلُ عَلَى الَّذينَ يَظلِمونَ النّاسَ وَيَبغونَ فِي الأَرضِ بِغَيرِ الحَقِّ أُولئِكَ لَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ﴾ [الشورى: ٤٢] وقال تعالى: ﴿أَلا لَعنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظّالِمينَ﴾ [هود: ١٨] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلا تَركَنوا إِلَى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النّارُ﴾ [هود: ١١٣] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلَو يَرَى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا إِذ يَرَونَ العَذابَ أَنَّ القُوَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَميعًا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ شَديدُ العَذابِ﴾ [البقرة: ١٦٥] وقال تعالى: ﴿فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصّاعِقَةُ بِظُلمِهِم﴾ [النساء: ١٥٣] وقال تعالى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدِي القَومَ الظّالِمينَ﴾ [المائدة: ٥١، الأنعام ١٤٤، القصص ٥٠، الأحقاف ١٠] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلَقَد أَهلَكنَا القُرونَ مِن قَبلِكُم لَمّا ظَلَموا﴾ [يونس: ١٣] وقال تعالى: ﴿ثُمَّ قيلَ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ذوقوا عَذابَ الخُلدِ هَل تُجزَونَ إِلّا بِما كُنتُم تَكسِبونَ﴾ [يونس: ٥٢] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلَو يُؤاخِذُ اللَّهُ النّاسَ بِظُلمِهِم ما تَرَكَ عَلَيها مِن دابَّةٍ﴾ [النحل: ٦١] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَإِذا رَأَى الَّذينَ ظَلَمُوا العَذابَ فَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنهُم وَلا هُم يُنظَرونَ﴾ [النحل: ٨٥] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَتِلكَ القُرى أَهلَكناهُم لَمّا ظَلَموا وَجَعَلنا لِمَهلِكِهِم مَوعِدًا﴾ [الكهف: ٥٩] وقال تعالى: ﴿قالَ أَمّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلى رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذابًا نُكرًا﴾ [الكهف: ٨٧] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَقَد خابَ مَن حَمَلَ ظُلمًا﴾ [طه: ١١١] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَسَيَعلَمُ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبونَ﴾ [الشعراء: ٢٢٧] وقال تعالى: ﴿فَيَومَئِذٍ لا يَنفَعُ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا مَعذِرَتُهُم وَلا هُم يُستَعتَبونَ﴾ [الروم: ٥٧] وقال تعالى: ﴿وَلَو أَنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ما فِي الأَرضِ جَميعًا وَمِثلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافتَدَوا بِهِ مِن سوءِ العَذابِ يَومَ القِيامَةِ وَبَدا لَهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ ما لَم يَكونوا يَحتَسِبونَ﴾ [الزمر: ٤٧] وقال تعالى: ﴿فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا مِن عَذابِ يَومٍ أَليمٍ﴾ [الزخرف: ٦٥] وبين الله سبحانه وتعالى ضرر الظلم وأنه يحيق بأهله ﴿وَلا يَحيقُ المَكرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلّا بِأَهلِهِ﴾ [فاطر: ٤٣] وظلم النساء سواء كن صغيرات أو كبيرات في أي مستوى من المستويات سواء تعلق الظلم بالبدن أو بالنفس أو بالمال أو بالعرض سواء كان بالقول أو بالفعل أو بالغمز واللمز أو بالإشارة أو بغير ذلك جميع أنواع الظلم حرمها الله سبحانه وتعالى٬ وقد ذكر الضرر النفسي فقال تعالى: ﴿وَلا تُمسِكوهُنَّ ضِرارًا لِتَعتَدوا وَمَن يَفعَل ذلِكَ فَقَد ظَلَمَ نَفسَهُ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٣١] فقد احتاطت الشريعة للحقوق وبينت ما هو عدل وما هو ظلم بما لا مزيد عليه ولا يمكن أن يأتي أحد بمثله ولا بقريب منه فضلا عن أن يأتي بما هو أحسن منه.

ومن المعلوم أن الله سبحان وتعالى حد حدودا وحرم أشياء ورتب عليها زواجر ولا يمكن أن ينزجر عنها الناس إلا بما شرعه الله سبحانه وتعالى ونحن نعلم أن الحدود معطلة في أكثر بلاد الأرض أو في كلها منذ زمن ولكن ذلك ما عاد على البشرية إلا بالضرر وفشو الانفلات الأمني والخراب في الديار والفساد المستشري٬ وهذه العقوبة العاجلة هي من عقوبات الظلم ومن عقوبات تعطيل الحدود وعقوباتها أكبر من ذلك ونسأل الله سبحانه وتعالى اللطف بعباده.

ومن المعلوم كذلك أن تبديل الحدود وتبديل الشرع أعظم من تعطيله. فالتعطيل جريمة لا محالة ولا شك في ذلك لكنه قد يضطر إليه الإنسان بسبب بعض الظروف لكن التبديل لا يضطر إليه الإنسان أبدا وهو محادة لله في حكمه فمن بدل شرع الله فجعل للزنى أو الاغتصاب أو اللواط أو غير ذلك عقوبات غير العقوبات التي حددها الله سبحانه وتعالى ورسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقد حاد الله في ملكه وبدل شرع الله وألغى كتاب الله وسنة رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم.

خامسا: أن القانون الجنائي الموريتاني ومدونة الأحوال الشخصية ليس فيهما ثغرة تتعلق بحقوق المرأة أو عقوبة الظلم أو الاعتداء حتى تسد بقانون جديد وإذا علم ذلك فلا داعي لهذا القانون غير الاستجابة لضغوط الشاذين والمفسدين والساعين لتفكيك الأسر وإفساد النسل، وأولئك لا يستطيعون مواجهة مجتمعنا المحافظ بدعواتهم الفاسدة إلا متسترين بحماية حقوق المستضعفين ورعاية دواعي المدنية والحداثة.

إن هذه النصيحة التي أسجلها في هذه الكلمات موجهة من واقع المحبة والنصح والإشفاق وهي موجهة لكل أهلنا في موريتانيا بمن فيهم رئيس الدولة والوزراء والنواب والقضاة والمحامون فكلهم لهم حظ من هذه النصيحة ولهم حظ من المحبة والدعاء ويجب علينا نصحهم والدعاء لهم نسأل الله تعالى أن يحفظهم جميعا ويوفقهم وأن يكفيهم عذاب الله وسخطه وأن يجيرهم من كل ذلك.

وخلاصة القول أن هذه القوانين التي فيها اقتراح عقوبات غير ما حدد الله أو فيها تحريم لأشياء لم يحرمها الله أو فيها إباحة لأشياء حرمها الله أنها محادة لشرع الله، وأن شرع الله فيه كفاية وفيه حماية وفيه رعاية لكل الحقوق وفيه زجر زاجر عن كل الآثام وكل الأضرار بما فيها الظلم والزنى والتحرش وغير ذلك من الكبائر والفواحش والآثام، والولاية على المرأة في النكاح هي من حمايتها ورعايتها. وقد فطر الله الآباء والأمهات على محبة الأولاد والبنات وإيثار مصالحهم فلا داعي للتدخل للأسر في شؤونها، وإذا ثبت ظلم أو تعد في داخل الأسرة فالقانون والقضاء له بالمرصاد دون حاجة إلى تشريع جديد.

نسأل الله تعالى أن يوفقنا وإياكم جميعا لكل خير وأن يأخذ بنواصينا وإياكم للبر والتقوى وأن يجعلنا الله وإياكم من الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه.

وصلى الله وسلم على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه أجمعين.
body_en:
In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds. I send blessings and peace upon the master of the first and the last, our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and his Companions and whoever is guided by his guidance and follows his sunnah until the Day of Judgement.

Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God and His blessings. My brothers, whoever of our people in Mauritania receives this: I wished to set out the measure that is agreed upon, on which no two Muslims who follow what the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) brought from God Almighty differ, in relation to this much-disputed law.

First: that the Muslims are all agreed that it is God Almighty who makes lawful and forbids and criminalises, and that none apart from God possesses that; God, glorified be He, is the Judge, He alone. God Almighty said: { Judgement belongs to God alone } [Sūrat Yūsuf 12:40], and God Almighty said: { And in whatever you differ, its judgement belongs to God } [Sūrat al-Shūrā 42:10]. He alone legislates, and legislation is a property of divinity; and it is for that reason that God Almighty said: { Or do they have partners who have ordained for them of religion what God has not permitted? } (Sūrat al-Shūrā 42:21)

And God Almighty said: { Say: have you considered what God has sent down to you of provision, and you have made of it forbidden and lawful? Say: has God permitted you, or do you invent falsehood about God? } (Sūrat Yūnus 10:59). And God Almighty said: { And do not say, of what your tongues describe falsely, "this is lawful and this is forbidden", so as to invent falsehood about God. Those who invent falsehood about God do not prosper } (Sūrat al-Naḥl 16:116). And God Almighty said: { Say: my Lord has only forbidden indecencies, what is open of them and what is hidden, and sin, and transgression without right, and that you associate with God that for which He has sent down no authority, and that you say about God what you do not know } (Sūrat al-Aʿrāf 7:33).

So it is not lawful for any human being to legislate what God has not permitted, nor to seek to have it enacted, nor to sign it, nor to vote for it, nor to take part in its approval; for God, glorified and exalted, is the One who makes lawful and forbids, and whoever decides contrary to His law, making lawful what God has forbidden or forbidding what God has made lawful, has opposed God in His dominion.

Second: that God, glorified and exalted, forbade fornication and made it an indecency among the greatest of the major sins, and attached to it one of His fixed punishments, whether this fornication be with a close relative or with an unrelated woman, with an older or a younger, with a willing or a coerced woman — in any circumstance whatever. Fornication is among the greatest of indecencies, and it is for that reason that God Almighty said: { And do not approach fornication; it is an indecency and an evil way } (Sūrat al-Isrāʾ 17:32).

God, glorified and exalted, forbade the believing man and the believing woman to approach it or anything that leads to it, and made it obligatory upon believing men and believing women to guard their private parts. God, glorified and exalted, said: { And those who guard their private parts ۝ except from their spouses or those their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy ۝ but whoever seeks beyond that, those are the transgressors } (Sūrat al-Muʾminūn 23:5-7). And God Almighty said: { Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private parts; that is purer for them. God is aware of what they do ۝ And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and guard their private parts, and not to display their adornment except what appears of it, and to draw their head-coverings over their bosoms, and not to display their adornment except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husbands' fathers, or their sons, or their husbands' sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women, or those their right hands possess, or male attendants having no physical desire, or children not yet aware of women's nakedness; and not to stamp their feet so as to make known what they hide of their adornment. And turn to God all together, O believers, that you may prosper } (Sūrat al-Nūr 24:30-31)

God Almighty attached to fornication one of His fixed punishments: upon the unmarried fornicator God Almighty made obligatory one hundred lashes and banishment for a year, and upon the fornicator who has been in a consummated marriage, whether male or female, the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) prescribed stoning to death. God Almighty said: { The fornicatress and the fornicator: flog each one of them with one hundred lashes, and let no pity for them take hold of you in the religion of God, if you believe in God and the Last Day; and let a group of the believers witness their punishment } (Sūrat al-Nūr 24:2)

And it is established in Sahih al-Bukhari, from the hadith of Umar ibn al-Khattab (may God be pleased with him), that among what God sent down upon His Messenger was the verse of stoning, and that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) carried out stoning, and his Companions carried it out with him. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) stoned five persons in his lifetime, of those who had committed fornication while in a consummated marriage. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) also set out some of what relates to fornication by way of penalties other than this, such as what relates to the oath of mutual imprecation (liʿān) and the severing of paternity and other matters; and God, glorified and exalted, set out in His Book what fornication is established by, in the way of testimony, and set out likewise what the oath of mutual imprecation is completed by, in the way of oaths.

So every act of harassment, or anything leading to gratification with a woman whom it is not lawful for a man to take pleasure in, or with a man whom it is not lawful for a woman to take pleasure in, is likewise among the indecencies and the major sins; and for what falls short of fornication among these there is attached a discretionary penalty which the ruler determines by what will serve as a deterrent to people.

There is no doubt that sins increase according to their circumstances, so that their punishment in the hereafter increases and their punishment in this world is made more severe according to their circumstances likewise. Fornication with close relatives is graver than fornication with unrelated women; fornication with women who are coerced and raped is graver than fornication with willing women; and fornication with married women is graver than with unattached women, because all of these involve rights owed to others. God, glorified and exalted, has said: { And those who do not call upon another god alongside God, nor kill the soul which God has forbidden except by right, nor commit fornication — and whoever does that will meet a penalty ۝ The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide in it humiliated ۝ except one who repents and believes and does righteous work; for those, God will change their evil deeds into good ones, and God is Forgiving, Merciful } (Sūrat al-Furqān 25:68-70).

Third: that God, glorified and exalted, has given every holder of a right his right. He determined what rights belong to men and what rights belong to women, and set that out in His Book, and His noble Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) set it out. God, glorified and exalted, said: { And they have rights like those due from them, according to what is recognised as right; and men have a degree over them } (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:228). And God Almighty said: { Do not prevent them from marrying their husbands when they have agreed between themselves according to what is recognised as right } (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:232). And God Almighty said: { O you who believe, it is not lawful for you to inherit women against their will, nor to constrain them so as to take away part of what you have given them, unless they commit a clear indecency. And live with them according to what is recognised as right; and if you dislike them, it may be that you dislike a thing in which God has placed much good } (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:19).

On this basis no new right can afterwards be acquired, because God has completed the religion and said: { This day I have completed your religion for you, and have perfected My favour upon you, and have approved Islam for you as religion } (Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:3). So the rights are what the Lawgiver has determined and set out. These are the rights God has appointed for every individual in society, and they are set out and clear, with no difficulty in them.

Fourth: that every infringement of rights, or injustice, is likewise among the greatest and gravest of the major sins. God forbade injustice to Himself and made it forbidden between His servants, as in the sound divine saying: "O My servants, I have forbidden injustice to Myself and have made it forbidden among you, so do not wrong one another." God has praised Himself as one who does not wrong, and said: { Indeed God does not wrong people in anything; rather it is people who wrong themselves } (Sūrat Yūnus 10:44). And God Almighty said: { Indeed God does not wrong by the weight of an atom, and if there is a good deed He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward } (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:40). And God Almighty said: { And your Lord is not unjust to His servants } (Sūrat Fuṣṣilat 41:46).

God has set out the danger of injustice, its forbiddenness and its harm. God Almighty said: { And those whose scales are light, those are the ones who have lost their own souls by having wronged Our signs } (Sūrat al-Aʿrāf 7:9). And God Almighty said: { So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky, for the wrong they used to do } (Sūrat al-Aʿrāf 7:162). And God Almighty said: { And if every soul that has done wrong had all that is on the earth, it would offer it as ransom. They will conceal their regret when they see the punishment, and it will be judged between them in equity, and they will not be wronged } (Sūrat Yūnus 10:54). And God Almighty said: { And whoever among you does wrong, We will make him taste a great punishment } (Sūrat al-Furqān 25:19). And God Almighty said: { The way [of blame] is only against those who wrong people and transgress in the earth without right; for those there is a painful punishment } (Sūrat al-Shūrā 42:42). And God Almighty said: { Behold, the curse of God is upon the wrongdoers } (Sūrat Hūd 11:18). And God Almighty said: { And do not incline towards those who do wrong, lest the Fire touch you } (Sūrat Hūd 11:113). And God Almighty said: { And if only those who do wrong could see, when they see the punishment, that all power belongs to God and that God is severe in punishment } (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:165). And God Almighty said: { So the thunderbolt seized them for their wrongdoing } (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:153). And God Almighty said: { Indeed God does not guide the wrongdoing people } (Sūrat al-Māʾidah 5:51, Sūrat al-Anʿām 6:144, Sūrat al-Qaṣaṣ 28:50, Sūrat al-Aḥqāf 46:10). And God Almighty said: { And We destroyed the generations before you when they did wrong } (Sūrat Yūnus 10:13). And God Almighty said: { Then it will be said to those who did wrong: taste the punishment of eternity; are you recompensed for anything but what you used to earn? } (Sūrat Yūnus 10:52). And God Almighty said: { And if God were to take people to task for their wrongdoing, He would not leave upon it a single creature } (Sūrat al-Naḥl 16:61). And God Almighty said: { And when those who did wrong see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be granted respite } (Sūrat al-Naḥl 16:85). And God Almighty said: { And those towns — We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed for their destruction a fixed time } (Sūrat al-Kahf 18:59). And God Almighty said: { He said: as for the one who does wrong, we shall punish him; then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment } (Sūrat al-Kahf 18:87). And God Almighty said: { And he who bears wrongdoing has failed } (Sūrat Ṭā Hā 20:111). And God Almighty said: { And those who have done wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned } (Sūrat al-Shuʿarāʾ 26:227). And God Almighty said: { On that day the excuse of those who did wrong will not benefit them, nor will they be allowed to make amends } (Sūrat al-Rūm 30:57). And God Almighty said: { And if those who did wrong had all that is on the earth, and the like of it with it, they would offer it as ransom from the evil of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection; and there will appear to them from God what they had not reckoned with } (Sūrat al-Zumar 39:47). And God Almighty said: { So woe to those who did wrong, from the punishment of a painful day } (Sūrat al-Zukhruf 43:65).

God, glorified and exalted, set out the harm of injustice and that it recoils upon those who commit it: { And evil scheming encompasses none but its own people } (Sūrat Fāṭir 35:43). And injustice towards women — whether they be young or old, at any level whatever, whether the injustice relates to the body, or to the person, or to property, or to honour, whether it be by word or by deed or by winking and taunting or by gesture or by anything else — all kinds of injustice, God, glorified and exalted, has forbidden. He mentioned psychological harm and said: { And do not retain them so as to cause harm and thereby transgress; and whoever does that has wronged his own soul } (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:231). The Sharia has thus taken the utmost care for rights and has set out what is justice and what is injustice, in a way that cannot be added to, and to which no one could bring the like, nor anything near it — let alone bring what is better than it.

It is known that God, glorified and exalted, laid down fixed limits, forbade things, and attached deterrents to them, and that people cannot be deterred from them except by what God, glorified and exalted, has legislated. We know that the fixed punishments have been suspended in most of the countries of the earth, or in all of them, for a long time; but that has brought upon humanity nothing but harm, the spread of lawlessness, ruin in the lands and rampant corruption. This immediate punishment is among the punishments of injustice and among the punishments of suspending the fixed limits, and their punishments are greater than this. We ask God, glorified and exalted, to be gentle with His servants.

It is likewise known that altering the fixed limits and altering the law is graver than suspending them. Suspension is a crime, no doubt about it; but a person may be driven to it by certain circumstances, whereas alteration is something a person is never driven to, and it is opposition to God in His ruling. So whoever alters the law of God, appointing for fornication, or rape, or sodomy, or anything else, penalties other than the penalties which God, glorified and exalted, and His Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) determined, has opposed God in His dominion, and has altered the law of God, and has annulled the Book of God and the sunnah of His Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him).

Fifth: that the Mauritanian penal code and the personal status code contain no gap relating to the rights of women, or to the punishment of injustice or of assault, such that it would need to be filled by a new law. If that is known, then there is no occasion for this law other than responding to the pressures of those who deviate and those who corrupt and those who seek to dismantle families and to corrupt offspring; and those people are not able to face our conservative society with their corrupt calls except under cover of protecting the rights of the weak and of attending to the requirements of civility and modernity.

This counsel which I set down in these words is offered out of love, sincere advice and compassion, and it is addressed to all our people in Mauritania, including the head of state, the ministers, the deputies, the judges and the lawyers; all of them have a share in this counsel, and they have a share in the love and the supplication. It is incumbent upon us to counsel them and to pray for them. We ask God Almighty to protect them all and to grant them success, and to spare them the punishment of God and His anger, and to save them from all of that.

The sum of what is said is that these laws, which contain proposals of penalties other than what God has determined, or which contain the forbidding of things God has not forbidden, or which contain the permitting of things God has forbidden, are opposition to the law of God; and that the law of God is sufficient, and contains protection, and contains attention to all rights, and contains a deterrent that deters from every sin and every harm, including injustice, fornication, harassment and the rest of the major sins, indecencies and sins. Guardianship over a woman in marriage is part of her protection and of attending to her. God has made fathers and mothers by nature love their sons and daughters and prefer their interests, so there is no occasion for interference in families' own affairs; and if injustice or transgression within a family is established, the law and the judiciary are watching for it, without any need for new legislation.

We ask God Almighty to grant us and you all success in every good, and to take us and you by the forelock to piety and God-consciousness, and to make us and you among those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it.

May God bless our Prophet Muhammad and grant him peace, and his family and his Companions all together.

flags.arabic: وعلى الزاني المحصن سواء كان ذكرا أو أنثى فرض رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الرجم إلى الموت
flags.context: the second section, on the fixed punishment for fornication
options: hold the record from publication pending legal advice in each jurisdiction, as recommended here
publish the full text with a prominent contextual and legal banner
publish only the sections on rights and on injustice, and withhold the section on the fixed punishments
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, the highest exposure in this slice. The text states, in the Sheikh's own voice, that the Prophet prescribed stoning to death for the married fornicator, that the Prophet stoned five persons, and that altering these penalties is opposition to God. Published in English and read out of context in the UK, the EU, the US, Canada or Australia, this engages hate-speech and incitement law in several jurisdictions and, quite apart from law, is the single most damaging passage in the corpus if it circulates without its setting. The translation is faithful and has been neither softened nor strengthened: الرجم إلى الموت is 'stoning to death' and has not been muffled; المحصن is rendered 'who has been in a consummated marriage', which is the technical condition, not simply 'married'. The reader must also see that the Sheikh is stating the classical law and its evidentiary requirements, not calling for anyone to act. The publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, with legal advice, and must never be taken by default.

flags.arabic: الاستجابة لضغوط الشاذين والمفسدين والساعين لتفكيك الأسر وإفساد النسل
flags.context: the fifth section, on why the law was proposed
options: those who deviate (literal, keeping the Arabic's own register)
sexual deviants — in contemporary Arabic al-shādhdhūn is the standard pejorative for homosexual people
those who depart from the norm
flags.note: CRITICAL TRANSLATION CHOICE, deliberately not resolved. الشاذ literally means anomalous or deviant, and in classical usage carries no sexual sense at all; but in contemporary Arabic media and religious discourse الشاذون is the standard, and pejorative, way of referring to homosexual people, and the same paragraph pairs it with 'dismantling families' and 'corrupting offspring', which points that way. The choice between options 1 and 2 decides whether the English page reads as a general complaint about social corruption or as an attack on a protected group, and in the UK, the EU and Canada that difference is the difference between lawful religious opinion and a possible offence. The neutral literal rendering has been used in body_en. Only the Sheikh's office can settle which sense was intended, and the decision must not be made by a translator.

flags.context: the title and the subject of the whole fatwa
options: the gender law — the Mauritanian bill on the protection of women and girls from violence, known in French as the loi sur le genre
the gender law (literal, with no gloss)
flags.note: The referent is a specific Mauritanian legislative proposal on violence against women and girls, repeatedly brought before and rejected by parliament between 2016 and 2021. النوع here is a calque of French genre and does not mean 'type' or 'kind'. An English reader given only 'the gender law' will not know what is being opposed, and the record's force depends entirely on knowing it; but supplying the gloss in body_en would add context the Sheikh does not give, so it is recorded here instead. The display must carry it.

flags.arabic: فرض على الزاني البكر ... جلد مائة وتغريب سنة ... والحكم الشرعي ... محادة لله في ملكه
flags.context: the ruling vocabulary throughout, in the Sheikh's own voice
options: apply the fixed five-rulings mapping throughout, as done here
flags.note: Recorded, not uncertain. Every ruling word in this text is the Sheikh's own, not a reported school position, so the fixed mapping of style guide section 3 applies without qualification and has been applied: حرم / محرم 'forbade / forbidden', أوجب / يجب 'made obligatory / obligatory', لا يحل 'not lawful', يبيح 'permits'. The Sheikh writes in his own Maliki voice, in which farḍ and wājib are not distinguished, so فرض is rendered 'made obligatory' and 'prescribed' according to whether the agent is God or the Prophet, matching the Arabic's own distinction. محادة is 'opposition to' — literally standing on the opposite boundary — and is not rendered as 'unbelief' or 'apostasy', which the Arabic does not say.

translator_notes: الزنى is rendered 'fornication' throughout, the term covering all unlawful intercourse whether or not either party is married; 'adultery' would be narrower than the Arabic and would misdescribe the unmarried case the text treats separately.

حد (pl. حدود) is rendered 'fixed punishment' / 'fixed limits' — the penalties whose measure is fixed by revelation — and kept distinct from تعزير, the discretionary penalty, which is rendered 'discretionary penalty'. Neither is in the glossary; both should be added.
المحصن is 'who has been in a consummated marriage', the technical condition, rather than simply 'married'. The distinction is load-bearing for the ruling.
اللعان is 'the oath of mutual imprecation (liʿān)', the procedure by which a husband's accusation and a wife's denial are sworn; not in the glossary.
التحرش is rendered 'harassment', which is what the modern Arabic term means; the text treats it as a category attracting a discretionary penalty.
اللواط is rendered 'sodomy', the act, which is what the Arabic names; it is listed alongside fornication and rape as an offence whose penalty the Sheikh says may not be altered.
ولاية in the last paragraph is 'guardianship' over a woman in marriage, the walī of the glossary.
الأمر بالمعروف vocabulary does not appear here; the counsel at the end is نصيحة, sincere advice, and is rendered 'counsel'.

Qur'anic renderings in this corpus are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic. Where the source supplies the sūrah and verse, that reference is given in round brackets; where the source supplies none, the reference has been supplied in square brackets and is marked as supplied.
The source uses the Arabic semicolon-like mark ٬ in several places where a comma is expected; preserved in body_ar.
This record has no embedded media at all: it is a written statement, not a transcript of a recording.

Records across this slice carry timestamps clustered minutes apart on the same day (e.g. 1038/1039/1040 at 08:13/08:14/08:14 on 8 August 2019; 1077/1078/1079 at 09:50/09:52/09:53 on 22 July 2020), which is the signature of a batch upload. date_is_cms_upload is therefore set true throughout.
